title: UX-01: Director's rework decision (D30), design review gate and proposed rework design
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Decision D30 recorded: the Director's answers to the audit's questions. Gate plus independent review (Impeccable detector as a blocking check; sub-agents authorized for independent reviews; every design declined where the agent cannot directly prove its work); a complete, original rework (legacy stylization as inspiration only; 3D animated interactive pack opening; binder pages that flip at a stable aspect ratio; an interactive board with its own identity); procedural ink artwork.

Design review gate (D30) in packages/design-system: scripts/design-review-lib.mjs (engine pin, viewports, story selection, exception validation requiring a Director decision, design-source fingerprint, review-record checks), scripts/design-review.mjs (fetches and verifies the pinned Impeccable engine v0.1.16, serves the Storybook build on 127.0.0.1:6008, scans every reference story except documentation pages at 1440x900 Ink and Paper, 820x1180 Ink and 390x844 Paper, the four viewports in parallel; any unwaived finding declines), scripts/check-design-reviews.mjs (a passing design and evidence record from separate reviewers at the current design source for every reference screen), design-review/exceptions.json (empty) and design-review/README.md; package scripts design-review and check:design-reviews.
scripts/ci/design-system.mjs gains stages design-review-detector (reusing the browser stage's Storybook build) and design-review-records after the browser suite.

tests/design-review.test.mjs: engine pin, exceptions need a Director decision and a reason, waiver matching, reference-story selection and globals, documentation pages left out, and review records rejected when missing, stale, declined, written by one reviewer twice or without a full report.

Found while building the gate, fixed before the receipts: the gate served Storybook from its own Node process and waited on the engine synchronously, so no request was ever answered and every scan in the container timed out; the engine now runs as an asynchronous child process. The engine launches Chromium without its sandbox (CI=1), as Playwright does in this container, against the local build only.

RUN-20261023-003 (headless browser, expected failure: declined): 385 Impeccable findings across 63 reference stories (1440 Ink 154, 1440 Paper 154, 820 Ink 25, 390 Paper 52), identical to the host audit, in 129 s including the Storybook build. RUN-20261023-004 (static, expected failure: declined): no screen has an independent review record.

Proposed rework design (docs/plans/2026-10-23-ux-01-rework-design.md): a world of ink, paper and light (procedural InkField, paper sheets, room key lights, ink accents, brush and ink-ring shape language, motion budgets), room compositions from each task (the Illuminary 3D pack opening, the Lorebook binder with 3D page turns at a fixed size, the Inkfield match with the Lore Stream and interactive play, quest and challenge, the Scriptorium deckbuilder where the deck is its curve), the room frame, four boundary choices for the Director and the proof each claim needs.

ADR 0017 amendment (design review gate), design-system and CI runbooks, design-system README, validation section, status lines in AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/README.md, UX-01 backlog status, plan status lines, documentation map (design-review README current; rework design planning) and HANDOFF.md.

RUN-20261023-005 (isolated design-system pipeline, expected failure): gates 40/40, browser suite 409/409, then the design review detector declined the screens (385 findings) and stopped the job, in 518 s.

verification.scope: Design review gate, detector stage, on the current reference screens: an expected failure. 385 Impeccable findings across 63 reference stories at four viewport and theme combinations decline them; the stage works end to end in the container (headless browser).
Design review gate, record stage: an expected failure. No reference screen has an independent review record, so all five are declined (static).

Actual isolated design-system pipeline with the new stages (container): design-system gates 40/40, pinned Chromium, the Playwright/axe suite 409/409, then the design-review-detector stage declined the reference screens with 385 Impeccable findings, so the pipeline stopped there (518 s). An expected failure: it proves the gate blocks the job until reworked screens pass.
Checkpoint full suite at the new source fingerprint: configuration contract, CI configuration, dependency audit, typecheck, lint and every workspace test (container).

docs:check run before this record's documentation review was complete (static): it failed with 'Missing documentation review: docs/schemas/card-certification.schema.json'. Preserved; the review was added and RUN-20261023-008 rechecks.

limitations: The Impeccable detector is a floor: it catches mechanical and generated-design tells but cannot judge identity, which the independent design review exists for.
The hosted design-system job fails at the gate until reworked screens pass it; this is the intended effect of D30.
The rework design is a proposal; no direction-study prototype exists yet.
next_actions: Build the direction-study prototypes in the rework design's order, each passing the detector and two independent reviews before the Director sees it.
The Director approves or changes the direction study and the four boundary choices; then the implementation plan and full build.
